source_discrepancies.classification: Repulsion/universal motors and reluctance starting are taught as syllabus-listed related single-phase AC machines,not incorrectly called ordinary induction motors.
source_discrepancies.efficiency_test: Alternator OCC/SCCyield synchronous impedance,not efficiency by themselves;loss/input data are additionally required.
source_discrepancies.standards: Applicability and editions must be checked;IE classes are not blanket ratings for every synchronous alternator.

safety: Machine laboratory work is qualified-supervised only;415V/mains/rotating equipment is not a home experiment.Protection,earthing,guards,verified isolation and safe stored-energy discharge are mandatory.
